analyses.title: Global well-posedness and growth of Sobolev norms for nonlinear Dirac equations with Yukawa potential on compact manifolds
analyses.abstract: In this paper we study a nonlinear Dirac equation with intrinsic Yukawa potential on compact manifolds. In dimension 2, and in dimension 2 after projection onto the positive-energy sector, we prove global well-posedness together with exponential upper bounds on the growth of higher-order Sobolev norms. The main ingredient that allows to extend the local solutions, which are constructed by standard contraction argument, is a commutator-based higher-order energy method, combined with Grönwall's lemma, which provides the necessary a priori Sobolev bounds on the solutions.
analyses.progressType: 紧流形上带 Yukawa 势非线性 Dirac 方程的全局适定性
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究紧 Riemann 自旋流形上的 intrinsic Yukawa 非线性 Dirac 方程。二维无投影方程和三维正能量投影方程都先用收缩映射建立局部解，再以守恒 $L^2$/能量、Yukawa 椭圆平滑和基于 Dirac 对易子的高阶能量估计控制 Sobolev 范数；最终以 Grönwall 排除有限时间爆破，并得到高阶范数的单指数增长。

analyses.title: Level sets of fractional Sobolev functions
analyses.abstract: We prove a coarea-type result for scalar functions $f$ in fractional Sobolev spaces $W^{s, p} (Ω)$ with $Ω\subset \mathbb R^n$, $0<s<1$, and $1\leq p < \infty$. Our theorem shows that a.e. level set has zero Hausdorff $\mathcal{H}^{n-s}$ measure, where the level set $f^{-1} (y)$ is defined as the set all points at which $y$ is between the $\liminf$ and the $\limsup$ (as $r\downarrow 0$) of the averages of $f$ over the balls $B_r (y)$. A quite general construction of random series of wavelets shows also that with probability $1$ (many) level sets have indeed dimension $n-s$.

analyses.workSummary: 论文研究分数阶 Sobolev 函数的水平集。作者先证明一般函数的水平集 Hausdorff 测度上界，再用间歇随机小波级数证明该维数在大量水平集上可以达到，从而把上界和典型性构造放在同一套容量与随机过程框架中。
techniques: 分数阶 Sobolev 差商与 Littlewood–Paley 分解

analyses.title: Weighted estimates for the stability operator of the helicoid on slowly varying domains
analyses.abstract: We consider the poisson problem $\wt{\mc{L}} u = E$ for the operator $\wt{\mc{L}} = Δ_{\mb{R}^2} + 2\cosh^{-2}(s)$ on domains of the form $Λ: = \{ (s, z): |s| \leq \ell(z) \}$, where the width $\ell(z)$ of the domain $Λ$ varies with $z$. We prove the existence of solutions satisfying weighted estimates when the source term satisfies certain natural orthogonality conditions, and when $e^{-\ell}$ is small and slowly varying.

analyses.workSummary: 论文研究螺旋面稳定算子 $\widetilde L=\Delta+2\cosh^{-2}(s)$ 在宽度缓慢变化的无限长区域上的 Poisson 问题。源项满足与低阶核函数强正交时，作者构造具有局部加权 Schauder 估计的解，并给出适用于变化尺度区域的局部化、截断和迭代机制。
techniques: 螺旋面稳定算子的奇偶分解与核密度条件
缓慢变化尺度函数和加权 Hölder 范数

analyses.title: A continuous data assimilation method for a variant of Oberbeck-Boussinesq system with randomly perturbed data
analyses.abstract: We show convergence of a continuous data assimilation method for the Oberbeck-Boussinesq system in the dimension $d=2,3$. Our working hypothesis is boundedness of the reference solution, while the synchronized solution satisfies the equations in a weak sense. The main tool is the relative energy inequality for stochastic problems.

analyses.workSummary: 论文研究带随机观测扰动的 Oberbeck–Boussinesq 系统连续数据同化。参考解满足有界性条件，同步解只要求弱鞅解；作者以相对能量不等式控制速度和温度误差，证明当观测增益足够大、插值尺度足够小时，同步解在概率平均意义下逼近参考解，并量化模型耗散、插值误差和随机噪声的贡献。
techniques: Oberbeck–Boussinesq 方程的弱鞅解框架

analyses.title: Subcritical-mass global solvability in a doubly degenerate Keller-Segel system with signal production
analyses.abstract:
We consider the initial-boundary value problem for a variant of the Keller-Segel chemotaxis system with doubly degenerate diffusion, i.e. we study \[ \left\{  egin{array}{ll} u_t = 
abla \cdot (uv
abla u) - 
abla \cdot (u^2v
abla v),\ v_t = Δv + u - v,\ (uv
abla u-u^2v
abla v)\cdotν=
abla v\cdotν=0,\ u(x,0)=u_0(x),\quad v(x,0)=v_0(x), \end{array} ight. \] in a smoothly bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^2$. Crucially, we only assume the sufficiently regular initial data to be nonnegative, but allow those functions to be zero at non-trivial parts of the domain. We show that, despite possibly starting from a degenerate state, the system admits global solutions in a framework of generalized energy solutions, whenever the initial mass is below the threshold number $m_0=4π$. Moreover, in a radial setting the threshold number can be increased to $m_0=8π$.

analyses.title: Stability and strong convergence for complex Hessian equations with $L^1$ data
analyses.abstract: We study complex $m$-Hessian equations on bounded hyperconvex domains with right-hand side in $L^1(Ω)$. The main contribution of this paper is a strong stability result for weak solutions in the Hessian energy sense. More precisely, if $f_j \to f$ in $L^1(Ω)$ and $u_j, u$ are the corresponding solutions, then \[ \int_Ω|u_j-u|\, H_m(u_j) \longrightarrow 0. \] This provides convergence in the natural energy topology associated to the Hessian operator, which is significantly stronger than convergence in capacity. For completeness, we also recall the existence of solutions and stability in capacity, which follow from known results in the literature.

analyses.title: Classification of singular solutions to the subcritical Lane-Emden equation in $\mathbb{R}^N \setminus \{0\}$
analyses.abstract: We provide a classification result of positive solutions with a non-removable singularity at the origin to the subcritical Lane-Emden equation $-Δ_p u = u^q$ in $\mathbb{R}^N \setminus \{0\}$, where $p\in(1,N)$, $q\in (p-1,p^*-1)$ and $u^{q-p+1} \in L^{\frac{N}{p}}(\mathbb{R}^N \setminus B_R)$.

analyses.title: On the rigidity of Finslerian conformal circle-preserving transformations
analyses.abstract: We prove that if a forward or backward complete Berwaldian or reversible Finslerian manifold $(M,F)$ admits a non-trivial (non-homothety) conformal concircular transformation ({\bf c}ircle-{\bf p}reserving {\bf t}ransformation or {\cpt} for short), $e^σ F$, where $σ$ has at least one critical point, then, $(M,F)$ is Riemannian. Consequently, $(M,g)$ is conformally diffeomorphic to either 1) the standard sphere, 2) the Euclidean space, or 3) the hyperbolic space. In particular, a compact Berwaldian or reversible Finslerian manifold does not admit any non-trivial conformal {\cpt}s, unless it is conformally diffeomorphic to the standard sphere.

analyses.workSummary: 论文证明：若前向或后向完备的 Berwald 流形或可逆 Finsler 流形存在带临界点的非平凡共形圆保持变换，则该 Finsler 结构必为 Riemannian。局部上作者把正则水平集写成 warped product，再在临界点附近证明理想水平度量具有常正旗曲率，最后用可逆或 Berwald 情形的刚性定理消去 Cartan 张量。

analyses.title: Discretisation of Eulerian nonlinear elasticity and diffusion using gradient flows
analyses.abstract: In this study, we introduce a general energy-based modelling approach for viscous poroelastic materials that feature diffusive transport in both Lagrangian and Eulerian frames. Our research produces refined weak formulations by using the reference map concept within the Eulerian configuration. We propose and implement a novel structure-preserving discretisation strategy, utilising mixed finite element methods. This paper highlights the spatial and temporal numerical convergence of our methods through a comparative analysis of Lagrangian and Eulerian schemes, thereby proving the robustness and usability of our approach. Furthermore, in the context of Eulerian multiphase flow, specifically of the quasi-static Euler-Euler type, our study demonstrates the existence of solitary fluid waves within poroviscoelastic media. This energy-based approach forms a basis for a deeper understanding of thermodynamical modelling and corresponding discretisation schemes for coupled poroelasticity, flow, and diffusion.

analyses.title: Root Dynamics of Differentiated Polynomials with Rotationally Invariant Structure
analyses.abstract: The dynamics of polynomial roots under repeated differentiation has recently been conjectured to converge to a limiting measure governed by specific nonlinear PDEs, the conjectures being shown in some particular settings. For rotationally invariant initial distributions, a deterministic structured sampling model placing roots on concentric circles was recently introduced by Galligo, Najnudel, and Vu. In this paper, the authors proved convergence under the technical growth condition $m_n / (n \log n) \to \infty$, where $n$ is the number of circles and $m_n$ is the number of points per circle. In this paper, we significantly improve this result by relaxing the growth condition to $m_n / \log n \to \infty$, thus allowing for regimes where the number of points per circle grows proportionally to the number of circles. The key innovation is a refined upper bound on the root magnitudes after differentiation. This sharper estimate prevents the rapid accumulation of errors over multiple differentiations, fully validating a recent conjecture regarding the robustness of the sampling scheme.

analyses.title: From graphons to real-world networks: kinetic opinion dynamics under selective media influence
analyses.abstract: We propose a kinetic model of opinion dynamics under selective media influence on both graphon-based and real-world networks. The media action, inspired by Hallin's theory of spheres, is incorporated through a model predictive control strategy designed to steer agents' opinions toward a desired target opinion. For the resulting Boltzmann-type description, we analyse the evolution of the moments and, in the quasi-invariant interaction limit, derive a Fokker--Planck-type equation together with a characterisation of its stationary states. We also prove exponential convergence to equilibrium in the Fourier metric. Numerical experiments are performed on networks generated by a Gaussian graphon and on real-world, single-issue Twitter networks, allowing us to investigate the role of control and interaction parameters, as well as the impact of the subset of agents subject to media influence. Using real-world social networks data to initialise opinions and infer the interaction structure, we then compare the dynamics obtained on the original networks with those produced by Gaussian graphons fitted to their adjacency matrices, thereby assessing the descriptive power of the graphon approach for real-world opinion dynamics.

analyses.title: Localization and unique continuation for the Anderson-Bernoulli model with long-range hopping on $\mathbb{Z}$
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study Anderson localization near the spectral edge for the Anderson-Bernoulli model on $\mathbb{Z}$ with long-range hopping. When the hopping has a rational Laurent symbol, a quantitative version of the unique continuation principle can be proved, and localization occurs. For the unique continuation in the general case, we give some counterexamples and prove a weaker result for hopping that decays faster than exponential rate. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first localization result for the long-range Anderson model with pure Bernoulli potentials.

analyses.title: Solutions for Strongly Monotone Operator Equations in Riesz Spaces
analyses.abstract: This paper is devoted to the study of solutions for a class of operator equations governed by strongly monotone operators on real Riesz spaces continuously embedded into Banach lattices. By exploiting the intrinsic lattice structure of Banach lattices, we establish refined growth assumptions on nonlinear terms to guarantee that suitable neighbourhoods of positive and negative cones are invariant under the descending flow. Combining the descending flow invariant set technique with the theory of strongly monotone operators, we derive abstract existence theorems: the operator equation possesses at least one positive solution, one negative solution and one sign-changing solution. These abstract results are further applied to \((p,q)\)-Laplacian boundary value problems, yielding corresponding multiplicity conclusions on positive, negative and sign-changing solutions.

analyses.workSummary: 论文在连续嵌入 Banach 格的实 Riesz 空间中研究强单调算子方程。作者通过正负锥邻域在下降流下的不变性，结合强单调算子和相对 Morse/不变集方法，得到至少一个正解、一个负解和一个变号解，并应用于 (p,q)-Laplacian 边值问题。

analyses.breakthrough: 抽象结果把强单调可逆解算子 A、锥邻域收缩和下降流不变集组合起来，在不依赖普通 Palais–Smale 形式的条件下强制产生三种符号类型的临界点；第 3 节逐项验证 (p,2)-Laplacian 假设，从而获得边值问题的三解结论。
analyses.limitations: 多重解结论依赖 (H1)–(H4) 的强单调、增长和紧性条件以及 Riesz/Banach 格结构；应用只覆盖所列 (p,2)-Laplacian 边值模型。部分拓扑/下降流引理来自此前文献，本文的核心是将其适配到正负锥和变号解分离。

steps.claim: 强单调算子生成连续双射解算子 A。
steps.route: Lemma 2.1 由 hemicontinuity 和强单调增长给出 T:X→X* 的满射与单射，Corollary 2.1 再给出逆映射连续；因此每个 u 都有唯一 $v=A(u)$ 满足 $T(v)=f(u)$。

steps.claim: 正负锥邻域在 A 下收缩，且可构造保持符号区域的下降方向。
steps.route: 对 $v=A(u)$ 的负部/正部测试方程，强单调性与 f 的增长条件给出距离锥的幂次估计，得到 Lemma 2.2；再把 A−u 局部修正为 B−u，Lemma 2.3 同时保留锥邻域并保证 J′(u) 沿该方向严格下降。

steps.claim: 闭不变集的下降流下界是临界值，并分别产生正、负、变号临界点。
steps.route: Lemma 2.4 用流方程 $u_t=B(u)-u$ 和能量耗散微分不等式 (2.12) 把不变集的下确界提升为临界值；结合 Lemma 2.5 的连通分支和 Lemma 2.6 的有限维分离，再对 D+、D− 及其补集应用，完成 Theorem 2.1 的三类解存在性。
